item.title: Programmable Logic Controller (PLC)
item.description:
Correction | Procurement | Award | $330K | Vendor: Tomex Electronics Inc

The New York City Department of Correction (NYCDOC) seeks a qualified M/WBE-certified vendor to develop and implement a comprehensive integration of the Departments existing Programmable Logic Controller (PLC)based jail control panels with the Genetec Security Center platform. The project encompasses two independent cell wings, each containing 48 inmate cells and 4 auxiliary rooms (totaling 104 access points across both wings). Each wing operates using its own PLC hardware and wiring infrastructure, which must be integrated into DOCs unified Genetec security ecosystem for centralized command, monitoring, automation, and video-assisted situational awareness. This modernization initiative aims to replace manual, panel-based workflows with automated, rules-driven functionality, enhancing operator efficiency, reducing human error, and improving DOCs ability to escalate, track, and respond to security-critical events in real time

item.title: HHAP Insurance Navigation
item.description:
Health and Mental Hygiene | Procurement | Award | $1.7M | Vendor: Fedcap NYC Inc

In January 2015, the New York City (NYC) Department of Health and Mental Hygiene (Health Department) launched Harlem Health Advocacy Partners (HHAP), a place-based initiative demonstrate the capacity of a community health workers to improve the health of residents of public housing in East and Central Harlem. The long-term goal of HHAP is to improve the population health of residents of public housing in East and Central Harlem and to close racial gaps in health and social outcomes. Based on current needs, the Health Department is seeking a contractor to provide continued insurance enrollment, insurance and healthcare navigation, and medical billing assistance in support of HHAP.

item.title: FPHNY Grant Development and Fundraising
item.description:
Health and Mental Hygiene | Procurement | Intent to Award | Due: 2026-06-10

Pursuant to Section 3-05 of the New York City Procurement Policy Board Rules, the Department of Health and Mental Hygiene (DOHMH) intends to enter into negotiations for a five-year agreement with Fund for Public Health in New York, Inc. (FPHNY) for the purchase of grant acquisition, fundraising, grant management and project management needs.

FPHNY was created in 2002 as an independent nonprofit organization to partner closely with NYC DOHMH to further its mission of improving the health of all New Yorkers. FPHNY contributes to the advancement of public health in NYC by: a) soliciting funds for both project and general support from public and private funding sources and donors who would or could not ordinarily support government initiatives, and; b) by providing a vehicle for effective administration of grant funds for pilot projects or time-sensitive grant programs.
